title: Andhra Pradesh Reports Omicron RF.5 Variant, Health Minister Assures No Need to Panic
summary: Andhra Pradesh has reported 12 new COVID-19 cases and four deaths over the past three weeks. The state's health minister has confirmed the presence of the Omicron RF.5 variant but downplays concerns, stating there is no need to panic. This development comes as some doctors have expressed caution due to the resurfacing of COVID-19 in the region.
summary_points: Andhra Pradesh has reported a recent surge in COVID-19 cases and deaths
The Omicron RF.5 variant has been detected in the state
Health officials are taking precautions to prevent further spread
Some doctors have expressed concern over the resurfacing of COVID-19
The government is assuring citizens that there is no need to panic
